sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. After a recent loss, Sandbach will be looking to bounce back against struggling Alsager, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 games and have won only once all season. This should offer Sandbach a good opportunity to return to winning ways and extend their lead at the summit.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town on Saturday, seeking to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth (3rd) welcome Eccleshall (5th) in a fixture between two in-form sides, with Bridgnorth having won four of their last five despite two recent defeats, while Eccleshall are riding a five-game winning streak. Wolverhampton Casuals (4th) visit Wednesfield Community (9th) on Saturday before hosting Brereton Social on Wednesday evening; Casuals are in decent form with three consecutive wins. Bilston Town (6th) host Foley Meir (13th) in a match-up between mid-table and struggling sides. Barnton (7th) visit Shawbury United (15th), who are in freefall with six consecutive losses. Market Drayton Town (10th) host New Mills (8th) in a contest between teams around mid-table. Crewe (16th) entertain Allscott Heath (11th) on Saturday; Crewe are struggling while Allscott have shown some recent promise. Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th) travel to face Telford Town (18th) in a bottom-half clash between two sides with minimal points. Finally, Brereton Social (14th, at home on Saturday) take on Widnes Town (20th), the division's only winless side with 2 points from 7 games.
